violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: BAKING DISHES AND UTENSILS WASHED, RINSED AND PLACED TO AIR DRY WITHOUT SANITIZING .
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER UTENSILS TO SANITIZER SOLUTION IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING BEFORE PLACING TO AIR DRY. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RED BEAN BUN AT 76F IN SELF SERVICE RACK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. EHS ADVISED PIC TO MAINTAIN TCS PASTRIES EITHER AT 41F OR BELOW OR 135F OR ABOVE UNLESS USING TPHC PROCEDURES. PIC INDICATED TPHC PROCEDURES WILL NOT BE USED BUT TCS PASTRIES WILL BE MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW. IN REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED HOT SHOT INSECTICIDE SPRAY UNDER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED FROM ESTABLISHMENT DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ONLY CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE IS USED AT ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CREAM CAKE AT 44F, MANGO MOUSSE AT 44F, CHEESECAKE AT 44F IN DISPLAY (RIGHT); WHOLE MILK AT 51F AND REDUCED MILK AT 51F IN GALAXY 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATOR .
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: GALAXY 1 DR UNDER COUNTER AT 52F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED MILK PLACED IN UNIT 3 HOURS PRIOR TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL, REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE REFRIGERATION UNITS ARE ADJUSTED TO OPERATE BETWEEN 34-38F WITH DEFROST CYCLES DURING CLOSED PERIODS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS in the KITCHEN is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT APPROPRIATE FREQUENT CLEANING SCHEDULE.
